template_data.headline_html: Five questions before you sign anything.

items.title: Who's bringing the work?
items.sub: Confirm the prime has an active pipeline — not just a plan to find work someday.

items.title: Who owns the customer post-award?
items.sub: That relationship is worth more than this contract. Don't let it default by accident.

items.title: Is your scope in writing?
items.sub: Verbal agreements vanish. If it's not in the teaming agreement, it doesn't exist.

items.title: What's your exact sub percentage?
items.sub: "Best efforts" is not a number. Get a written percentage before you sign.

items.title: Can you claim past performance?
items.sub: Confirm it explicitly — that credit is often the entire point of teaming as a new entrant.
